verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms GitHub offers issue creation and project management (github-docs-12), roadmap-to-task organization (github-docs-8), and issues as a first-class object reachable via the MCP server (github-docs-29). That supports basic tracking of features and bugs, but nothing in the pack covers milestones, time tracking, or issue dependencies; github-docs-6 is about package dependencies, not issue dependencies. Missing for 10: milestones, time tracking, issue dependencies/blocking relationships, in-depth issue docs, independent corroboration.
